user.title: Grid and house
user.description: Pick the power sensors for grid and house. At least grid import, grid combined or house consumption is required. Combined sensors are signed, separate ones report positive values.

storage.title: Solar and storage
storage.description: Optional: solar production and storage. Multiple sensors per field are summed.

data.battery_grid_charge: Storage charged from grid (optional, part of “To storage”)

devices.title: Devices
devices.description: Optional: name patterns with * as wildcard, e.g. *_power. Every power sensor whose name matches is listed on the House tab. You can also add single sensors.

error.no_source: Please provide grid import, grid combined or house consumption.
error.invalid_pattern: Only letters, digits, _ . * and ? are allowed.
